caseNameFull: Fernand V. Gasquet v. George F. Lapeyre

opinions.text: November 15, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of Louisiana denied. Mr. J. C. Gilmore, Mr. Thomas Gilmore,Mr. William Winans Wall and Mr. G. T. Fitzhugh for petitioner. No appearance for respondents.
